title: Piano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x='10' y='35' width='80' height='45' rx='4' fill='#5B2C8D'/>
  <!-- Top panel lighter shade -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='72' height='12' rx='2' fill='#7B4FB5'/>
  <!-- Keyboard base -->
  <rect x='14' y='52' width='72' height='20' rx='2' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <!-- White keys -->
  <rect x='16' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='26' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='36' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='46' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='56' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='66' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='76' y='54' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x='22' y='54' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3A2860'/>
  <rect x='32' y='54' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3A2860'/>
  <rect x='52' y='54' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3A2860'/>
  <rect x='62' y='54' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3A2860'/>
  <rect x='72' y='54' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3A2860'/>
  <!-- Piano lid top -->
  <rect x='8' y='28' width='84' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4A1F75'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on the top panel -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2CEAA3'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2CEAA3'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 46 Q50 54 62 46' fill='none' stroke='#2CEAA3' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='2' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='2' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Music notes floating -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='20' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='27' y='10' width='2' height='10' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='18' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='77' y='8' width='2' height='10' fill='#FFD166'/>
</svg>
